name: tractor_hydro_cvt
source: Tractor plan stage 2 [AS]: a single-range hydro-mechanical (power-split) CVT in the class of a Fendt Vario / Deutz-Fahr / Case IH CVXDrive tractor transmission, all numbers assumed. Continuous ratio k = w_out/w_in from 0 (active standstill) through reverse; k_max 1.35 puts the output at 2970 rpm at 2200 engine rpm (about 50 km/h on the data/vehicles/tractor.json driveline), reverse -0.5. Single mechanical point at k = 0.9 (real boxes have 2-4 ranges with a mechanical point each). hydrostatic_efficiency 0.85 (pump + motor, an axial-piston pair at rated pressure is 0.85-0.90 overall, Rexroth/Danfoss catalogue class) and mechanical_efficiency 0.97 (gear meshes). shift_clutch.capacity_nm is the hydrostatic pressure limit (relief valve) as torque at gearbox.out, 4500 N*m, about 5 x the 15 % slope holding need of a 6 t tractor+trailer. pump_drag_nm 10 [AS]. Inertias as the powershift box.
